title: Cheesy French Onion Hamburger Casserole
instructions: 1. Brown beef, onion, and garlic, then drain.
2. Add tomato paste, seasoning, Worcestershire, bouillon, and water.
3. Slightly cook potatoes, then toss with oil and onion soup mix.
4. Layer potatoes in baking dish, then add beef mixture.
5. Mix soup, milk, and pepper; pour over casserole.
6. Cover and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.
7. Top with cheese and crispy onions.
notes: Total Time: 1 hr 10 mins. Recipe by Eppic Recipes (Facebook).
